en.meta_desc: FairShare for university group work: tasks, docs, chat, contribution analytics, and optional AI insights — fairness, planning, moderation, and institutional reporting. Request a demo.
en.hero_lead: Track contribution, assign ownership, and eliminate free-riding in university projects.
en.trusted_blurb: FairShare supports transparent project delivery, contribution visibility, and staff oversight for group work.

en.problem_li3: No accountability without digging through chats and files
en.problem_fix_li2: Live progress tracking next to the work
en.problem_fix_li4: Easier moderation — fewer disputes, faster triage

en.faq_p: Answers for students, teams, and instructors evaluating FairShare.
en.faq0_b: FairShare is a platform built for university students working in teams. It tracks who contributes what on a group project, so everyone's work is visible and fairly recognised — not just the loudest voice in the room.
en.faq1_b_html: No. FairShare focuses on group project execution — tasks, docs, chat, and contribution signals. Most institutions keep Moodle, Canvas, Blackboard, or Google Classroom for modules, submission, and grades.
en.faq2_b_html: FairShare is a web workspace for university group projects that combines tasks, documents, chat, activity tracking, and contribution visibility in one place.
en.faq3_b: Each team member logs tasks, updates, and completed work directly in the platform. FairShare pulls this together in real time to show a breakdown of who is doing what — across writing, research, coordination, and other task types.
en.faq4_s: Can someone game the system by logging fake tasks?
en.faq4_b: Task logs are visible to the whole team and, where enabled, to your instructor too. This transparency makes it difficult to inflate contributions without others noticing. The platform is built around accountability, not just self-reporting.
en.faq5_s: What happens if a team member stops contributing?
en.faq5_b: FairShare flags low or no activity so it doesn't go unnoticed. Team members can raise this within the platform, and instructors can be granted visibility to step in if needed. It creates a paper trail so the issue is documented rather than ignored.
en.faq6_s: Can lecturers and tutors see team progress?
en.faq6_b: Yes. Instructors can be given dashboard access to monitor team activity, view contribution breakdowns, and track project milestones. This gives a much more accurate picture of group dynamics than a single submitted report.
en.faq7_s: Can FairShare data be used when marking group work?
en.faq7_b: That's entirely up to the instructor and their institution's policy. FairShare provides the data — contribution logs, activity timelines, and task completion records — which can inform decisions around differentiated marking if that's supported at your university.
en.faq8_b: By default, your contributions are visible to your own team. Instructor visibility is only enabled if your team or institution sets it up. You always have a clear view of who has access to your data within your project settings.
en.cta_p: Open the workspace now, and contact us if you need setup or rollout support.
en.foot_tag: Fair group work for schools and universities. Not affiliated with your institution unless contracted.
en.faq1_b: It's designed for university students who work in groups for assessed coursework. It's also useful for lecturers and tutors who want a clearer picture of how a team is actually functioning, not just what the final submission looks like.
en.faq2_b: FairShare offers a free tier for individual students to get started. Premium plans are available for larger teams and institutional access. Check the pricing page for the latest details.
en.faq9_b: FairShare is built on a Supabase backend with real-time data handling and secure authentication. Your project data is stored safely and is only accessible to authorised users within your team.
en.uni_value_p: FairShare cuts staff admin time in group modules by keeping tasks, activity, and contribution evidence in one place.
en.uni_value_c1_p: Tutors and lecturers no longer need to chase updates across email, chats, and multiple files.
en.uni_value_c1_l2: Faster visibility on progress and ownership
en.uni_value_c2_p: When questions come up, staff can review one clear timeline instead of rebuilding evidence.
en.uni_value_c2_l2: Better support for fair marking decisions
en.uni_value_c3_p: Low activity and imbalance appear earlier, so staff can step in before project outcomes drop.
en.uni_value_c3_l2: Target support where it is needed
en.uni_value_foot: Bottom line: keep your LMS for submission and grades, and use FairShare to manage the group-work process that consumes staff time.
en.uni_value_foot_text: keep your LMS for submission and grades, and use FairShare to manage the group-work process that consumes staff time.
en.ai_suite_h2: The AI features that matter most
en.ai_suite_lead_html: FairShare can turn tasks, chat, docs, and activity into short, plain-language takeaways — to support conversation and planning, not to auto-grade you. Schools choose whether AI is available.
en.ai_suite_list_you_html:
• Fairness & who did what — Explains contribution and balance in words everyone can follow.
  • Project health — A simple read on deadlines and activity so you know if things look stuck.
  • Next steps — Practical ideas for what to do or who to message this week.
  • Planning & teamwork — Milestones, priorities, uneven chat versus real work in the workspace, ideas for splitting or pairing tasks.
en.ai_suite_list_schools_html:
• Teaching & review support — Draft talking points for tutorials, checklist-style notes from chat and activity, and gentle writing cues for conversations (not automatic penalties).
  • School-ready reporting — Executive summaries, gradebook-mapping hints for IT, compliance-minded reminders, and softer language for families — designed to stay privacy-aware.
en.ai_suite_disclaimer_html: Will you see this? Only if your deployment runs the FairShare API with AI enabled. Your school sets policy. Read Security & trust for how data is handled.

tr.edu_p: Üç giriş noktası — aynı platform. Web siteniz ve ihale sunumlarınız için konumlandırma.
tr.edu_uni_p: Ders ekipleri ve laboratuvarlar, Moodle, Canvas veya Blackboard'a teslimden önce görev ve belge sahipliğinin net olmasını ister. FairShare LMS'in yanında yürütme içindir, teslim değil.
tr.edu_sixth_p: EPQ, BTEC ve A-level kohortları özerklik ile gözetimi dengeler. Katkı sinyalleri, notlar risk altına girmeden önce öğretmenlerin gruplara rehberlik etmesine yardımcı olur.
tr.edu_high_p: Korumaya duyarlı sohbet ve etkinlikle yapılandırılmış projeler. Politikanız gerektirdiğinde okul aracılıklı hesapları kullanın — yalnızca tüketici kaydı değil, kurumsal görüşmeleri destekliyoruz.

tr.about_contrib_p: Panolar katılım kalıplarını vurgular — eğitimciler için bir sinyal, otomatik hüküm değil.

İşleyici olduğumuzda Veri İşleme Anlaşmaları imzalar, alt işleyicileri belgeleriz ve saklama ile aktarım konusunda DPO'nuzla çalışırız. Bu hukuki tavsiye değildir — uygunluğu avukatınız teyit eder.

tr.faq_p: Answers for students, teams, and instructors evaluating FairShare.
tr.faq0_b: FairShare is a platform built for university students working in teams. It tracks who contributes what on a group project, so everyone's work is visible and fairly recognised — not just the loudest voice in the room.
tr.faq1_b_html: Hayır. FairShare grup proje yürütmesine odaklanır — görevler, belgeler, sohbet ve katkı sinyalleri. Çoğu kurum modüller, teslim ve notlar için Moodle, Canvas, Blackboard veya Google Classroom'u tutar.
tr.faq2_b_html: FairShare, üniversite grup projeleri için görevleri, belgeleri, sohbeti, etkinlik takibini ve katkı görünürlüğünü tek yerde birleştiren bir web çalışma alanıdır.
tr.faq3_b: Each team member logs tasks, updates, and completed work directly in the platform. FairShare pulls this together in real time to show a breakdown of who is doing what — across writing, research, coordination, and other task types.
tr.faq4_s: Can someone game the system by logging fake tasks?
tr.faq4_b: Task logs are visible to the whole team and, where enabled, to your instructor too. This transparency makes it difficult to inflate contributions without others noticing. The platform is built around accountability, not just self-reporting.
tr.faq5_s: What happens if a team member stops contributing?
tr.faq5_b: FairShare flags low or no activity so it doesn't go unnoticed. Team members can raise this within the platform, and instructors can be granted visibility to step in if needed. It creates a paper trail so the issue is documented rather than ignored.
tr.faq6_s: Can lecturers and tutors see team progress?
tr.faq6_b: Yes. Instructors can be given dashboard access to monitor team activity, view contribution breakdowns, and track project milestones. This gives a much more accurate picture of group dynamics than a single submitted report.
tr.faq7_s: Can FairShare data be used when marking group work?
tr.faq7_b: That's entirely up to the instructor and their institution's policy. FairShare provides the data — contribution logs, activity timelines, and task completion records — which can inform decisions around differentiated marking if that's supported at your university.
tr.faq8_b: By default, your contributions are visible to your own team. Instructor visibility is only enabled if your team or institution sets it up. You always have a clear view of who has access to your data within your project settings.
tr.cta_p: Çalışma alanını şimdi açın; kurulum veya yaygınlaştırma desteği için bize yazın.
tr.foot_tag: Okullar ve üniversiteler için adil grup çalışması. Sözleşme olmadan kurumunuzla bağlantılı değildir.
tr.faq1_b: It's designed for university students who work in groups for assessed coursework. It's also useful for lecturers and tutors who want a clearer picture of how a team is actually functioning, not just what the final submission looks like.
tr.faq2_b: FairShare offers a free tier for individual students to get started. Premium plans are available for larger teams and institutional access. Check the pricing page for the latest details.
tr.faq9_b: FairShare is built on a Supabase backend with real-time data handling and secure authentication. Your project data is stored safely and is only accessible to authorised users within your team.
tr.uni_value_foot_text: Teslim ve notlar için LMS’inizi koruyun; personel zamanını tüketen grup çalışma sürecini FairShare ile yönetin.
tr.ai_suite_lead_html: FairShare; görevler, sohbet, belgeler ve aktiviteyi kısa, sade çıkarımlara dönüştürebilir — konuşma ve plana yardım içindir, otomatik not değildir. Yapay zekânın açık olup olmayacağına okul karar verir.
tr.ai_suite_list_you_html:
• Adalet ve kim ne yaptı — Katkı ve dengeyi herkesin anlayacağı cümlelerle özetler.
  • Proje sağlığı — Son tarihler ve aktivite üzerinden işin takılıp takılmadığına basit bir bakış.
  • Sonraki adımlar — Bu hafta ne yapılabilir, kime yazılabilir gibi pratik fikirler.
  • Plan ve takım işi — Kilometre taşları, öncelikler, sohbetteki katılım ile üründe yapılan işin uyumu, görev paylaşımı ve eşleştirme fikirleri.
tr.ai_suite_list_schools_html:
• Öğretim ve gözden geçirme desteği — Derse yönelik taslak konu başlıkları, sohbet ve aktiviteden liste tarzı notlar, görüşmeler için nazik yazı uyarıları (otomatik ceza değil).
  • Kuruma hazır raporlama — Yöneticiler için özetler, BT’nin doğrulayacağı defter alanı önerileri, uyumluluk odaklı hatırlatmalar ve ailelere yumuşak dil — gizlilik düşünülerek.
tr.ai_suite_disclaimer_html: Görecek misin? Yalnızca kurulumun FairShare API'sinde YZ açıksa. Okul politikası belirler. Veri için Güven ve güvenlik sayfasına bakın.
